ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering Mismanagement of Funds in Minnesota
ideas.description: Investigate allegations of fraud and mismanagement of funds within the Minnesota Department of Human Services
questions: What is the extent of the alleged fraud?
How did the mismanagement of funds occur?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to uncover widespread corruption and mismanagement of funds, highlighting the need for increased transparency and accountability in government agencies.
